description: Audit a workspace: asynchronous security scan (polled within a bounded budget), dependency scan, vulnerable packages and SBOM. Precondition: the workspace runs. Reads only. A degraded scan is reported as scan_degraded, never as clean. If the scan is still running it returns pending with a resume_token; call again with it.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key; repeating the call with the same key and arguments is safe because every step reads state before writing.

resume_token.description: Opaque token from a pending result; pass it back unchanged with the same other arguments.
